_doc: The Ashwinter chapter 3 (betrayal): the clans and Clan Whaleroad (slot 2) march south against Greyhold (slot 1); Whaleroad turns when the clans hold both granaries north of Greyhold. Built from the frozen generator map gen:random_xl_3p_normal_normal_ring:11 by tools/maps/build_ashwinter_maps.py.
name: South

scenario.name: South for Bread
scenario.briefing: Clan Whaleroad marches south with you for Greyhold's grain. Take the granaries north of Greyhold; mind who stands beside you when the bread is won.

objectives.text: Keep Clan Whaleroad in the field.
Hold both granaries north of Greyhold.
Drive Greyhold and Clan Whaleroad from the field.

betrayal.text: Whaleroad has its bread. Whaleroad goes home.
